<<A Word About Mending Of Fishing Nets>>

Fishing nets are vital to the livelihoods of many communities, but they can be damaged during fishing trips, leading to waste and inefficiency. To address this, local initiatives have been launched to promote the mending of fishing nets. These efforts encourage fishermen to repair their nets instead of discarding them, which helps conserve resources and reduces environmental impact. Community workshops and partnerships with local organizations provide training on net mending techniques, ensuring that fishermen can maintain their nets for longer. By working together, communities can sustain their fishing practices while protecting marine ecosystems.
